subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should #100360 remain the coordination issue for both delivery-mirror side-branch replay poison and empty/signed Anthropic thinking replay, or be split/closed in favor of narrower canonical issues and PRs?
rationale: The source evidence shows two real overlapping failure families, and automation should not pick the canonical tracking boundary while focused PRs are still open.

options.title: Keep As Coordination Tracker
options.body: Keep #100360 open until the Anthropic replay candidate and the delivery-mirror candidate are resolved, then close it only with proof that both paths are covered.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move the Anthropic replay half to #99382/#99383 and the delivery-mirror half to #99470/#99504 or a new narrower issue, then close this as duplicate/superseded after cross-linking.

options.title: Close After One Candidate Lands
options.body: Close this when the highest-confidence candidate lands, accepting the risk that the other half may need a follow-up issue from fresh evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep As Coordination Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep #100360 open until the Anthropic replay candidate and the delivery-mirror candidate are resolved, then close it only with proof that both paths are covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is about maintainer-owned issue routing across provider replay and session-state repair candidates rather than a single mechanical code change.
